Show distinct expressive acting with a genuinely varied pose: a knowing smile, slightly lifted chin, one hand at the hip and the other near the chest. Keep normal pupils. Simple, readable hands near the torso; each visible hand has one anatomically correct thumb and four fingers connected to one palm and wrist. Do not force hidden digits into view.
